title: scPLATE-seq: Simple, Easily Automated Single-Cell 3’ Transcriptome Profiling
author: Jeremy Worley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s4hegt6
materials: Oligo(dT) mRNA capture primers, AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTAC[8 bp barcode]N (
ProtoScript II reverse transcriptase (NEB, #M0368X) MgCl 2 , 2M, cell culture grade (Fisher Scientific, #BP9741-10X
Exonuclease I, 20U/µl (Thermo Scientific, #EN0582) HyClone water (GE Healthcare, #SH30538.01)
Dynabeads MyOne Silane (ThermoFisher, #37002D) Buffer RLT Plus (Qiagen, #1053393) Ethanol, 200 proof (Sigma-Aldrich, #E7023)
Qubit 2.0 fluorometer (ThermoFisher) Qubit dsDNA high-sensitivity kit (ThermoFisher, #Q

Magnetic separators for 1.5ml and 15ml tubes (Invitrogen, #12321D and #12301D, or equivalent) Vortex mixer (Fisher #02-215-414, or equivalent) Multi-channel Pipettes (Integra Viaflow II, #4011, or similar) Eppendorf cold blocks (#022510541)

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis mix for each sample (making at least 1.2X the required volume). For 6µl of mix, combine 5.33µl Hyclone H2O, 0.15µl of 10% Triton X-100, 0.38µl of SUPERaseIN, and 0.15µl of 100mM dNTP mix. Final concentrations: 0.2% Triton X-100, 1U/µl SUPERaseIN, and 2mM dNTP mix.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Plates
steps.instruction: Load 6µl of lysis mix into each well of a 96-well plate using multi-channel pipettes or a liquid handling robot.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5µl of 10µM mRNA capture primers into each well.
Mix thoroughly and seal plates (use Biorad Microseal F foil or -80C safe film for frozen storage).
Centrifuge plate briefly at 4C to collect liquid.
Store plates at 4C for same-day use or at -80C for up to 1 month.
Centrifuge plate briefly to defrost and collect liquid.
Place plates in Eppendorf cold blocks.
Load samples into plates (if using FACS, align sorter using same model plates and ensure stream stability).
Thoroughly seal plates with -80C safe foil or optical seal.
Spin down for 2min at full speed, 4C (plates can be stored at -80C for up to two weeks).

steps.title: Prepare Reverse Transcription (RT) Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare 7.5µl of RT mix per sample (making at least 1.2X the required volume). Combine 3µl 5X RT buffer, 3µl of 5M betaine, 0.45µl of 200mM MgCl2, 0.075µl of 1M DTT, 0.2µl of 200U/µl ProtoScript II reverse transcriptase, 0.2µl of 20U/µl SUPERaseIN, 0.15µl of 100µM template switch oligo, and 0.43µl of Hyclone water.

substeps.instruction: Note: Final 15µl reaction concentrations: 1M betaine, 1X RT buffer, 6mM MgCl2, 5mM DTT, 40U RT enzyme, 7.5U SUPERaseIN, and 1µM template switch oligo.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Execute the RT process using a thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge RT mix at room temperature, full speed, for 2min.
Run primer anneal program: 72C (3min) then 4C (infinite).
Add RT mix to plate and mix thoroughly, keeping mix and plate near 0C.
Apply seal and quickly spin plate at 4C.
Run RT program: Stage 1: 42C (90min); Stage 2: 10 cycles of 50C (2min) and 42C (2min); Stage 3: 75C (10min), then 4C (infinite).

steps.title: Exonuclease I Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove unwanted DNA using Exonuclease I.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate briefly at 4C.
Dilute Exonuclease I to 7.5U/µl in 1X Exo I buffer and add 2µl (15U) to each sample; mix thoroughly.
Run Exo I program: 37C (30min) then 80C (15min) then 4C (infinite).

steps.title: Pool Samples and Clean Up
steps.instruction: Pool samples and perform silane bead cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate briefly at 4C and pool samples into a 15ml polypropylene tube.
Combine sample (e.g., 1400µl) with cleanup mix: 5 volumes RLT Plus (e.g., 4,900µl), EtOH to 33% final (e.g., 2,771µl), and 3µl silane beads for each 300µl solution (e.g., 91µl).
Vortex to mix and incubate at room temperature for 20min on a rotator.
Collect beads on magnetic stand, remove most supernatant leaving ~1ml.
Resuspend beads in remaining 1ml supernatant and transfer to a 1.5ml tube.
Collect beads on magnetic stand and remove supernatant.
Wash beads 2X with 500µl 80% EtOH.
Remove remaining EtOH with p10 tip and dry pellet in hood (do not over dry).
Elute in 100µl Hyclone H2O. Vortex for 1min, then flick or briefly pulse in microcentrifuge.
Incubate 1min at room temperature, collect beads on magnet, and remove supernatant into two PCR tubes (47.5µl each).

steps.title: SMART PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the library using KAPA HiFi HotStart.

substeps.instruction: Add 50µl 2X Kapa HiFi Hotstart and 2.5µl 10µM SMART PCR primer (AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGT) into each tube.
Mix and quickly spin down PCR mix.
Run SMART PCR program: Stage 1: 98C (3min); Stage 2: 98C (20sec), 67C (15sec), 72C (5min); Stage 3: 72C (5min), then 4C (infinite).
Note: Use 13-20 cycles depending on cell type (e.g., 14 for large cell lines, 18 for small primary cells) to avoid over-amplification.

steps.title: Post-PCR Cleanup and QC
steps.instruction: Clean the amplified product and verify quality.

substeps.instruction: Pool the two PCR reactions into a 1.5ml tube and measure total volume (slightly < 200µl).
Clean up using Ampure XP with 0.7:1 ratio; elute in 22µl Hylcone water.
Transfer 20µl to a new tube, ensuring no beads are transferred.
Determine library concentration using 3µl of sample for Qubit HS analysis (target: 0.1-0.4ng/µl).
Determine average library size using Bioanalyzer DNA HS (target: 1,600-1,900bp).

steps.title: Nextera XT Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare final sequencing libraries with modified Nextera XT parameters.

substeps.instruction: Load 0.5ng of sample into the tagmentation reaction (instead of 1ng).
Use 5µl of Index 1 (i7) adapter/primer and 5µl of 5µM Nextera PCR primer.
Perform cleanup with 0.6X:1 ratio Ampure XP, followed by 1:1 ratio Ampure XP cleanup.
Elute in 22µl RSB.
Verify on Bioanalyzer DNA HS (target size: 300bp to 600bp; no primer dimers).
